place_fields.vibe: quiet rocky hill trek with panoramic sunrise views
place_fields.summary: Horagina Betta is a hill and trekking destination in the Nandi Hills range near Chikkasagarahalli, known for rocky trails, scrub and grassland scenery, and broad views over the surrounding countryside.
place_fields.best_time: early morning, especially for sunrise; October-March is generally favorable

planning_attributes.description: Scenic hill trek near Nandi Hills with a relatively quiet trail and panoramic viewpoints.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Approach from Bengaluru via NH 44 toward Chikkaballapur, then SH 104/Nandi Cross toward the Nandi Hills area and the Horagina Betta trail access near Chikkasagarahalli.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Some routes may require forest-department permission; rules can vary by route and conditions.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Rocky and steep sections can be slippery; carry sufficient water and use suitable trekking footwear. Night starts require a reliable headlamp and are safer with an organized group.
planning_attributes.notes: Published trek sources place the attraction in the Nandi Hills range and describe it as an easy-to-moderate to moderate trek.

place_fields.vibe: rugged hill fortress trek with sunrise views
place_fields.summary: Kalawara Betta, also known as Skandagiri or Kalavara Durga, is a prominent hill near Chikkaballapur with a rugged trekking route, rocky terrain, forested sections, and views toward the surrounding hills.
place_fields.best_time: early morning for sunrise; October-March is generally favorable

planning_attributes.description: Popular hiking destination and hill landmark near Chikkaballapur, associated with Skandagiri and Kalavara Durga.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: Published sources report the summit at roughly 1,315 metres; map data lists the peak at about 1,450 metres.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Skandagiri is also known as Kalavara Durga and is described as an ancient mountain fortress.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Chikkaballapur and continue toward the Kalavara/Skandagiri trail area; the trek starts from the hill base and climbs to the summit.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Advance booking or forest-management entry controls may apply; verify current entry requirements before trekking.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The trail is rocky and challenging, with sustained climbing. Wear sturdy hiking shoes, carry water, and take care on loose or slippery sections.
planning_attributes.notes: The supplied coordinates are preserved exactly; published map data places Kalawara Betta at approximately 13.4173, 77.6827.

place_fields.vibe: scenic hilltop viewpoint and temple setting
place_fields.summary: Avalabetta Top View is a hilltop viewpoint in the Avalabetta area of Chikkaballapur, associated with the Lakshmi Narasimha cave temple and a short climb offering broad views of the surrounding landscape.
place_fields.best_time: October-March; morning and late afternoon are generally comfortable for the climb and views

planning_attributes.description: Hilltop scenic viewpoint near the Avalabetta Lakshmi Narasimha temple complex.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Avalabetta is also associated with the name Dhenugiri; local accounts connect the hill with the Lakshmi Narasimha cave temple and traditional legends.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Travel toward Avalabetta Road and Yarramaranahalli in Chikkaballapur district, then continue to the hilltop viewpoint and temple area.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The former Hanging Rock viewpoint has been restricted for safety; remain on designated accessible areas.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The climb includes approximately 205 steps and monkeys may be present near the temple; use caution around exposed viewpoints and do not approach restricted edges.
planning_attributes.notes: The supplied coordinates are preserved exactly. The listed place name refers specifically to the top-view viewpoint.
